title: Sentry scratch notes - Marlo
content:
Purpose: quick personal scratchpad for SOC2-ish prep. Not polished — thinking out loud. Use this to capture where evidence lives, what I tried, and what to ask folks in sync.

Scope: infra + hosted API + private deploys surface. Focus on access controls, key custody, deployment change logs, and incident detection wiring.

High-level timeline (my view):
- Feb 2026: gather obvious artifacts (KMS policies, IAM roles, demo logs)
- Mar 2026: fill gaps (runbook screenshots, export retention settings), loop in SRE and infra sec
- Apr 2026: dry-run attestation narrative + mock auditor Qs

Quick evidence map (draft):
- Logical access: org SSO config screenshot (okta-admin > org settings), monthly user review report (gdrive/eng/people-access/reports/2026-01.pdf). Owner: Ava.
- Privileged access: list of admin IAM roles + last-used timestamps (aws -> iam -> credential report). Command I ran: aws iam generate-credential-report && aws iam get-credential-report --output text > cred-report-2026-02-14.txt. Owner: Noah.
- Key management: KMS key list + rotation policy + HSM integration note. Evidence paths: infra/keys/kms-rotation-policy.md, terraform state references in repo infra/terraform/kms.tf. TODO: confirm HSM usage for private-deploy keys. Owner: Marlo.
- Change control / deployments: rollout audit logs (console and CI). Need: per-deploy changelog (git tags + build id). Where: github/actions/runs -> link + internal release spreadsheet (product/releases/2026-q1.csv). Owner: release-eng.
- Logging & monitoring: retention policy doc, alerting runbook snapshot. Evidence: observability/alerts/export/retention-policy-90d.md + screenshots of PagerDuty escalation policy. Owner: SRE.

Gaps I see (quick):
- No single canonical naming for evidence files (we have mixed repo names and drive docs). Suggest: evidence/<control-id>/<artifact-type>-<YYYYMMDD>
- Missing a clear artifact for onboarding/offboarding (proof of deprovisioning step executed). We have the playbook but not final deprovision run logs. Request: HR->IT offboard tickets extract for last 6 months.
- Need clear SLA for rotation of API keys used by internal services (where are they stored? vault vs repo?).

Audit narrative snippets (very rough):
- "Separation of duties is enforced via role-based access in Okta and AWS IAM; privileged roles are granted through a group sync process and reviewed quarterly. See evidence: okta-admin-groups-2026-01.pdf, cred-report-2026-02-14.txt."
- "Key material is managed by AWS KMS with rotation enabled; private-deploy customer keys are stored in an HSM-backed vault. See infra/keys/kms-rotation-policy.md and ops/hsm-integration-notes-2025-11.docx."

Questions / things to ask during sync:
- SRE: can you export last 12 months of deploy audit logs (git sha, actor, timestamp)? Where do we store those?
- Platform eng: confirm where runtime service accounts secrets live — Vault or encrypted S3? Who rotates them?
- People ops: can we get the CSV of terminated employees for 2025 with provisioning timestamps (redact PII)?
- Legal: any customer contracts requiring stricter retention than our default 90d logs?

Mini-runbook for pulling evidence I used (so I don't forget):
- IAM credential report: aws iam generate-credential-report; aws iam get-credential-report --query 'Content' --output text | base64 -d > cred-report.csv
- KMS keys: aws kms list-keys --query 'Keys[].KeyId' | xargs -n1 aws kms describe-key --key-id > kms-keys-brief.json
- Cloudtrail: console -> event history -> filter by resource -> export to S3 -> copy link to drive

Decisions I'm leaning toward:
- Rename evidence folder pattern to: evidence/<control>-<owner>-<YYYYMMDD> to avoid duplicates.
- Start a weekly sync between Trust Ops + SRE to triage missing artifacts; first meeting: Mar 10.

Notes to self:
- Keep short audit narratives (1-2 paragraphs) tied to 2-3 artifacts per control. Auditors want traceability: control -> activity -> artifact.
- Make a one-page cheat sheet for eng managers: "what to save when you deploy" (changelog, runbook version, rollbacks).

Random brain dump (possible tests/mini-evals):
- Sample an offboard: pick a person terminated in last 6 months, verify access removed from Okta, AWS, and internal dashboards. Document timestamps.
- Canary key rotation: rotate a non-prod KMS key and document downstream service impact and mitigation steps.

Next actions (my checklist):
- [ ] Ask SRE for deploy audit export (JIRA: SEC-598)
- [ ] Create evidence folder template in Drive and seed with two controls
- [ ] Confirm HSM statement with infra (who is using HSM vs standard KMS)
- [ ] Draft 1-page manager cheat sheet and share with product Eng leads

End-of-note: this is personal scratch — will formalize after clearing gaps. Keep this file as my 'what I tried' log so auditors can see iteration.

Timestamped log (short):
- 2026-02-14: Started initial mapping, generated cred report
- 2026-02-20: Met with SRE, got list of alerts and PD policy screenshot
- 2026-03-05: Ran through KMS key list; left HSM question in slack #infra-keys (ts=1710001234)
